rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with the provided 2AB/full blastocyst description, noting compact ICM and looser TE, but it introduces uncertainty about stage terminology and adds image-based details that are not clearly verifiable from a single static image.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, smoking, endometriosis, and first-cycle status well, though it could more explicitly weigh how endometriosis severity and fresh-transfer context modify prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent overall, with prognosis appropriately balancing favorable age/reserve against smoking, endometriosis, and non-top-tier morphology; only minor issues from speculative comments and an incomplete ending.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading principles and standard IVF counseling, including caution that lab grading outweighs single-image review and emphasizing smoking cessation; minor deviations include somewhat loose stage terminology and a few speculative recommendations.

Provides practical next steps for proceeding with transfer, luteal support, smoking/alcohol counseling, and future planning, but recommendations remain somewhat general and the future-cycle section is truncated.
